operator:intersects.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23 (docs/collision.md): mattes of 32-bit alpha images come from alpha, and both sprites are placed with rotation and flips. Driving sweep: 0 of 342 clear paths blocked (was 124); real walls stop within 2 px. Rotation rule and alpha threshold still to confirm in Dirapi.dll.

call:keypressed.game_usage: The arena polls the arrow keys (Mac codes 123-126) and letters/punctuation every frame to build the robot's key map.
call:keypressed.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23: a plain call no longer reaches a sprite behavior's handler of the same name (the robot behavior has its own keyPressed), and punctuation maps to Mac key codes. Verified by driving.

method:fadeout.game_usage: Fades a sound channel out over 400-1200 ms.
method:fadeout.evidence: Implemented; upstream stops the channel when the fade reaches silence.

the:systemdate.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. date .seconds now counts from midnight (Director's documented value; a read gave 48006 at 13:20). The arena's pacing and walkover timer only act when it grows, so it stalled at each minute.

prop:seconds.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. See systemDate: seconds since midnight.

machinery:machinery:tempo-timing.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. The busy-wait pacing in checkTempo reads (the systemDate).seconds, now seconds since midnight.

the:key.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. the key / the keyCode are the last key pressed (ScummVM, tested against Director, sets them on key-down only). Verified in game: with Up held, pressing 2/3/1 changes the follow camera distance 500->1000->1500->500.

call:numtochar.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. Windows-1252, as Director on Windows: numToChar(151) is the em dash. The Stats line now reads 'Ranking: <tab>—'; the em dash isn't drawn, apparently missing from the embedded Impact subset (font coverage not yet checked).

call:chartonum.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. Windows-1252, the inverse of numToChar.

call:rgb.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. rgb("0xRRGGBB") parses as hex like "#RRGGBB"; the garage's 'grey' preview shader and paint fills were teal. Verified: the garage robot renders grey.

prop:specular.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. shader.specular writes reach the shader (an earlier no-op arm caught them), and light.specular is honoured by the renderer (default TRUE, from the file flag or Lingo). Arena render unchanged apart from the robot's shine (mean difference 3.5/255).

method:setpixel.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. An integer on an indexed image is written as the palette index (the dictionary's raw pixel value), not matched as a grey. The robot paint maps are decoded this way.

prop:scriptinstancelist.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. Non-instance entries are ignored instead of raising; the garage assigns [new(...), 31] to its weapon popups and runs on in Director.

event:stepframe.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. No extra actorList stepFrame on mouseDown (Director sends stepFrame once per frame); it nudged the arena camera on every click.

call:offset.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. offset(rect, h, v) is the rect form; robot hit dents now get a valid rect.

machinery:machinery:mouse-hit-test.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23. Clicks go to the highest CHANNEL under the point (locZ changes drawing only), and 32-bit alpha bitmaps honour their authored alphaThreshold (byte 10 of the D7+ bitmap header, as ScummVM reads it). Inferred from the garage: four tab-bar headers are raised over the Paintshop/Buy/Sell hotspots by locZ, each opaque over its own tab with alphaThreshold 1, and the tabs work in Director. Verified: all four workshop tabs switch section.

prop:ink 6 (not reverse).game_usage: The robot list highlights the selected row with a grey filled shape in ink 6 over the name.
prop:ink 6 (not reverse).evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23: ink 6 XORs the source into the framebuffer (the RGB form of Not Reverse; ScummVM's 32-bit path does the same). Was drawn as a solid grey bar hiding the name; now an inverse-video highlight with the name readable.

machinery:machinery:builtin-tiles.game_usage: The arena's bottom panel is a shape filled with built-in tile 57; it shows through the battery as it drains.
machinery:machinery:builtin-tiles.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23: compared against Director's own tile bitmaps (RT_BITMAP 20-27 in Dirapi.dll, 8-bit with the Mac system palette). Tiles are now drawn through that palette (the arena palette made them red-speckled) and ScummVM's row-rotated data is rotated back (96% of tile 1's pixels match; the rest were lost in ScummVM's copy).

method:draw.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23: float coordinates are accepted (truncated, like other int coordinates), an unknown #shapeType such as the pen tool's #pen draws a #line (the documented default), #rect/#oval/#roundRect normalise reversed corners, and #rect draws #lineSize inset outlines. Tested by tools/paint-tests.js (6/6; the old build 0/6) and by drawing with every Paintshop tool. Still unconfirmed in Adobe's code: whether floats round or truncate, and whether #lineSize on #rect is inset or centred (Dirapi's image methods were not located).

method:fill.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23: float coordinates are accepted (truncated) and reversed rects are normalised, so the pen tool's dots (x - linewidth/2.0) and the mirrored eraser work. Tested by tools/paint-tests.js and in the Paintshop. Rounding vs truncation of floats is still unconfirmed against Adobe.

machinery:machinery:text-line-placement.game_usage: Buy parts category dropdown and part lists: Verdana 10 text members with fixedLineSpace 15, with per-row click boxes and the dropdown header placed around the text.
machinery:machinery:text-line-placement.evidence: Fixed 2026-10-23: system-font text drew each glyph at the top of its line, so with fixedLineSpace 15 the Buy parts lists sat 6px high: the first item hid under the dropdown header and the selection box straddled two items. Lines taller than their glyphs now put the extra space above the text (baseline one font descent above the line's bottom); the game's header and click boxes then centre on the text exactly. Tested by tools/buy-list-shot.js + tools/buy-list-check.py (fails before, passes after); robot list unchanged pixel for pixel. Not yet confirmed in Adobe's TextXtra code.
